title: Claims Platform Outage Response
description: Claims platform outages affecting insurance operations
immediate_actions: Assess impact on insurance operations and customer service
Implement manual claims processing if needed
Contact customer service team for claim inquiry management
investigation_steps: Review claims platform logs and status
Verify network connectivity to claims systems
resolution_steps: Restart claims platform services following standard procedures
Implement database fixes or restart if needed
Apply claims platform patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with claims platform vendor for complex issues
verification: Confirm with insurance staff that system is operational
special_considerations: Regulatory reporting deadlines require priority escalation
Claims processing is critical for insurance operations
Manual procedures may impact customer service levels
Coordinate with regulatory compliance team for reporting requirements
